name: EPIC 248536702
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 14.8 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248536702 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.777699 (16th-84th percentiles 14.519297-15.116532), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248536702: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4471.2305 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248536702 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3289.960938 (16th-84th percentiles 3244.960938-3339.804688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,290 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.80 solar masses and 14.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,471 K at its surface.
